_about: Public-domain Johannes Janssen (1829-1891, Frankfurt Catholic historian) in English for the Word Hoard: the History of the German People at the Close of the Middle Ages, 16 volumes and index (London: Kegan Paul, 1896-1925), translated by M. A. Mitchell and A. M. Christie (vols 1-2) and A. M. Christie (vols 3-16), from Internet Archive scans of the Toronto set. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
